text:
Optimus Prime: Awakening - Official Clip (2026) Peter Cullen
Don't miss the Official Clip for Optimus Prime: Awakening, an upcoming animated short to celebrate the 40th anniversary of The Transformers: The Movie. Fans of the franchise can hear the late and great Peter Cullen reprise his legendary role as Optimus Prime in Optimus Prime: Awakening, releasing in theatres internationally in 4K from September 17–22.

The short will be presented following select anniversary screenings of the original 1986 film. “Optimus Prime: Awakening” is a fully realized, 12-minute animated short designed as a love letter to the Transformers community and the late Peter Cullen, the legendary talent and voice of Optimus Prime. “Optimus Prime: Awakening” builds on the acclaimed storytelling and visuals of The Transformers: The Movie (1986), giving audiences the rare opportunity to experience the iconic cultural moment from the franchise’s past while exploring its future on the big screen. 

Optimus Prime: Awakening is releasing in theatres internationally in 4K from September 17–22.

Whalefall - Official Trailer 2 (2026) Josh Brolin, Emily Rudd, Austin Abrams
Take a look at the Official Trailer 2 for Whalefall, an action-adventure thriller film distributed by 20th Century Studios. Escape the belly of the beast in Whalefall, in theaters on October 16.

Whalefall follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

Whalefall stars Austin Abrams, Josh Brolin, Elisabeth Shue, Jane Levy, Emily Rudd, John Ortiz, and more. The film is directed by Brian Duffield and written by Daniel Kraus and Brian Duffield.

Whalefall is in theaters on October 16.
